title: BridgeMessage
description:
Simple Guitar C++ <-> React bridge protocol, v0. This schema is the single source of truth for the message layer: any new UI<->engine capability starts with a change here, and TypeScript types are generated from it (schema/gen-types.mjs -> schema/gen/ts/bridge.ts). Never hand-write the TS types.

Union of every message that can cross the bridge in either direction, discriminated by the `type` field.

SchemaVersion.title: SchemaVersion
SchemaVersion.description: Bridge protocol version. Bump this whenever a breaking change is made to any message shape in this file; engine and UI both check it on stateChanged so a stale webview bundle fails loudly instead of silently desyncing.

ParamId.title: ParamId
ParamId.description: Identifiers for host-automatable parameters exposed by the engine's APVTS. Currently only the M0 output gain passthrough param exists; new params are added here first.

NormalizedParamValue.title: NormalizedParamValue
NormalizedParamValue.description: A parameter value normalized to the JUCE APVTS convention of 0..1, regardless of the parameter's real-world range/units (e.g. outputGain's underlying range is -60..+12 dB). The engine owns the mapping in both directions.

DecibelValue.title: DecibelValue
DecibelValue.description: A signal level expressed in dBFS, as reported by a meter tap. Not clamped in the schema since engines may report -inf for digital silence; consumers should treat very negative / non-finite values as silence.

SetParam.title: SetParam
SetParam.description: UI -> engine. Set a parameter to a new normalized value, e.g. from a knob drag. The engine is the source of truth for the resulting real-world value and will echo it back via stateChanged.

UiToEngineMessage.title: UiToEngineMessage
UiToEngineMessage.description: Union of every message the React UI may send to the C++ engine.

MeterFrame.title: MeterFrame
MeterFrame.description: Engine -> UI. A single coalesced metering sample, pushed on a 30-60Hz timer off the audio thread (never per-block). M0 carries just the passthrough in/out peaks; more taps (per-block, tuner, etc.) are added as new fields in later milestones, not new message types.

ParamValueMap.title: ParamValueMap
ParamValueMap.description: Map of ParamId -> current normalized value, as sent in a full-state snapshot.

StateChanged.title: StateChanged
StateChanged.description: Engine -> UI. Full-chain parameter snapshot, sent on connect and whenever the engine-side state changes for a reason the UI didn't itself just cause (host automation, preset load, etc). Carries schemaVersion so the UI can detect a protocol mismatch against a stale bundle.

EngineToUiMessage.title: EngineToUiMessage
EngineToUiMessage.description: Union of every message the C++ engine may send to the React UI.
